messages:
ravi: Noticing spike in preemption of preemptible H100s in asia-southeast1 starting 2026-05-04T14:12Z. Several realtime pods OOM/killed and CA keeps oscillating.

ops-bot: alert: [gpu-eviction-rate] cluster-prod/asia-southeast1 rate=0.31 at 2026-05-04T14:13:05Z

emily: Seeing same. CA logs show failed scheduling because kubelet/device-plugin init delayed by image pull and nv_peer_mem failing, nodes Ready after ~6m but CA max provision time is 3m so it marks failure and removes group.

jordan: Two vectors: (1) slow node bootstrap caused by large container images + driver setup, (2) bursty transient traffic from batch jobs triggering autoscaler. Fixes: reduce image size, use imagePrePull DaemonSet, and introduce tiny reserved "burst-buffer" pool.

emily: Proposed hot-pool config:

```
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: gpu-burst-buffer
spec:
  initialNodeCount: 2
  autoscaling:
    enabled: false
  nodeConfig:
    machineType: n2-highmem-32
    accelerators:
      - type: nvidia-h100
        count: 1
    taints:
      - key: gpu.burst
        value: "true"
        effect: NoSchedule
```

ravi: We should also add image pre-pull via a DaemonSet with toleration so these reserved nodes have the inference image cached.

jordan: And bump CA --max-node-provision-time=15m and enable --balance-similar-node-groups. Also set --ok-total-unready-count=5 to tolerate a few slow nodes.

sre-oncall: Quick mitigation steps for oncall:
- scale up gpu-burst-buffer to 4 if eviction-rate > 0.25 for 5m
- temporarily lower realtime-infer concurrency by toggling rate limit in proxy
- mark noncritical batches with lower priorityClass so they don't preempt critical pods

emily: Another ops tweak: enable node auto-repair off for these spot pools to avoid kubelet restarts during churn; we'll rely on manual replacement for now.

ravi: Action items:
- emily: PR for DaemonSet image pre-pull + tolerations (ETA 2h)
- jordan: helm patch for CA flags + test in staging (ETA 1h)
- ravi: terraform for gpu-burst-buffer pool (ETA 3h)
- sre-oncall: add runbook step and pager threshold (ETA 30m)

ops-bot: incident created: INC-20260504-asia-spotsurge

ravi: I'll coordinate cross-region fallback as a follow-up. For now let's get pre-pull and hot-pool live. :rocket:
